decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The floodlights hereby approved shall not be used outside the following times:Monday to Sunday 	Dusk to 10.45pm

Condition : 3 - All floodlighting shall comply with and shall be designed in accordance with BS EN 12193:2007, Light and lighting - Sports lighting, and in accordance with the details shown in 40E-01, 02 and 03 and Technical Supporting Statement received 28th February 2011 and ADP160810 received 15th April 2011.Details certifying the floodlighting shall comply with the following criteria shall be submitted prior to use of the floodlights and the floodlights shall permanently comply with the criteria unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority : ? CIE 112, Glare Evaluation System for Use within Outdoor Sports and Area Lighting. ? CIE 150:2003, Guide on the Limitation of the Effects of Obtrusive Light from Outdoor Lighting Installations. ? The Institution of Lighting Engineers Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light (Character Area E1). ? The floodlighting luminaires shall be fitted with cowls/shields.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall not be commenced until details of the proposed louvers (hoods) including their design and application to the lights have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - 5.	The development hereby approved shall not commence prior to the submission to and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of details of a scheme for new trees to be planted on the land to the east of the site, along The Promenade. The trees shall be semi-mature evergreen species and sited to screen gaps between existing deciduous vegetation along the embankment adjacent to The Promenade and the site. The approved trees shall be planted in the first planting season following approval of the details and shall be replaced subject to approval from the Local Authority in writing with similar trees if they die within five years of being planted.
description: Reduction in height of eight existing floodlight columns and installation of hoods to twelve existing light fittings.
